pillar_reactions.evidence: Delivered briefly and generically rather than as a structured phase: 'we have the roadmap of how you look like that, what workouts to do, when to do them, how to do them, how to get your body moving right' and 'you're more athletic, and your joints have the full range of motion.' The prospect restated it back in his own terms, which is acceptance rather than enthusiasm: 'It's modifying and refining the skill set and targeting it with short, medium, and long-term goals in some format. Yes, I appreciate it. I get that, yeah.' Notably nothing was said about training around a knee awaiting ligament replacement.

The primal eating protocol was never delivered. Nutrition appeared only as a subordinate clause inside a longer sentence — 'how to eat so that you're, you know, you're cutting weight fast, and you're building muscle' — and no diet question was asked at any point in the call. This matters because the prospect's entire stated goal was abdominal fat: 'basically my gut or my midsection. I'd like it to be trimmer and just basically leaner.'

Presented in a single passage — 'we're keeping you accountable. We're helping you every step of the way. We're taking out all the thought process out of what routine to do' — and folded into the same restatement the prospect gave for the training pillar. He raised no questions about mechanics, cadence or format, which is a departure from every other prospect in this batch and consistent with a call where he had already concluded he could not participate.

anchors.raw: It would probably make more sense for you just to either start off with workouts from YouTube. You can follow Trevor's Instagram, just do workouts without paying.
anchors.competitor: Trevor's own free YouTube and Instagram content
anchors.note: Fourth call in this batch anchored on the founder's free content and the only one where the rep prescribed it himself. He was candid about the trade-off — 'Will it create a lasting transformation? Probably not, but at least getting you going' — which was the right thing to say to this prospect, but it establishes the free library as the company's own recommended substitute and is worth understanding centrally.

anchors.raw: Unfortunately, at the moment, it's actually just got a little bit sticky, where I am struggling, in all honesty.
anchors.note: Reinforced by 'London's not a cheap city to live' and by the loss of his clinic premises when workload collapsed. This is not price sensitivity or a competing anchor; it is an absence of capacity, which no payment plan and no value argument reaches. The rep recognised that and stopped.

anchors.raw: your administrator that I spoke to a few days ago, wasn't very forthcoming in terms of options. Um, she sort of sketched over very little... She didn't really give very much details nor did she ask for any pertinent points.
anchors.note: Recorded as an anchor because its absence is the finding: the prospect arrived with no price expectation, no qualification and an explicit grievance about the handoff. A setter call that neither frames cost nor asks qualifying questions puts the closer on a call with someone who cannot buy, and this is the second setter-quality signal in the batch after the pre-call kettlebell weight recommendation on the Cole Crossland call.

unmet_demand.want: A source of durable internal motivation. He asked the question outright and it is the clearest statement of demand anywhere in this batch: 'And where does one acquire that and maintain that?'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep answered 'that's a great question' and then listed what motivates other people — family, an ideal self, being a better father or business owner — before concluding 'it's not up to me to just come up with the reason.' The long-term-success pillar exists to answer exactly this and was never connected to it. The prospect went on to name this as the only thing holding him back.

unmet_demand.want: An affordable entry point while his income recovers — he needed to know what the cheapest real option costs.
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The self-serve platform was described ('better than his free stuff because it's all organized') and never priced, on this call or by the setter. A $199 monthly product was within reach of the conversation and the prospect was disqualified before it was quoted, so the affordable route was closed without being tested.

unmet_demand.want: Training that works around a right knee awaiting ligament or tendon replacement, where stairs are already restricted.
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Raised by the prospect in his first substantive answer, probed briefly, and then never referenced again. No adaptation, no contraindication discussion, no suggestion of clearance, and the programme was subsequently described as having 'really no excuse not to do it'.

unmet_demand.want: Nutrition guidance for abdominal fat loss, which is the whole reason he took the call.
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The nutrition pillar was never delivered and no diet question was asked, so the mechanism most directly responsible for his stated goal went entirely unaddressed.
